title: Argentinian Empanada Crispy Spring Rolls
description: A twist on traditional Thai spring rolls, we add crispy empanada dough and zesty Argentinian flair to this dish.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F.
Prepare empanada dough according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, sauté mixed vegetables and spring onion until softened.
Add cheese and stir until melted.
Cut empanada dough into thin strips.
Wrap empanada strips around vegetable mixture, sealing edges.
Deep fry empanada spring rolls until golden brown.
Drain excess oil and serve with zesty Argentinian sauce and crispy fried shallots.
